facets.add: log a thing by hand: name, form, next item
facets.recog: log from a photo: proposals, corrections, suggestions, recognisers
facets.edit: change or delete a thing's details
facets.qty: how many: counts, amounts, splitting identical things
facets.places: the place tree: make, rename, move, delete places
facets.away: where a thing is now: in use, away, kept together, lent
facets.search: find by name, tag or place
facets.surface: homepage, widget, object of the day, lock screen
facets.consume: use up stock: usage, minimum, run-out
